<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/notification_engine/health"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Return the notification engine's health status and consumer lag.

Reports:
- **status**: ``running``, ``degraded``, or ``stopped``, with the last
  evaluation time (Requirement 14.5).
- **consumer_lag**: lag for the engine's own consumer group
  (``linkiir.notification-engine``), so a DEBUG-level Rule falling behind
  is visible rather than suspected (Requirement 14.6).
- **disabled_rules**: IDs of rules auto-disabled due to faults.

Requirements: 14.5, 14.6
